sec: AIH Type-1: demographics, ANA, HLA associations, lymphoplasmacytic pathology, histological triad and acinus diagram

items.q: Autoimmune Hepatitis Type-1: which sex predominance and age band are printed?
opts: F >> M; 2nd to 3rd decade female population
M > F; 2nd to 3rd decade young male population
F > M 9:1; 4th to 5th decade perimenopausal women
items.exp: 'F >> M (2nd to 3rd decade female population)'. (Book p1023)

items.q: ANA is printed positive in what proportion of AIH Type-1 cases?
items.exp: 'ANA +ve (100% cases)' — repeated in the antibody table on p1024. (Book p1023)

items.q: ANA positivity is stated to be 'also in' two other conditions. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
opts: Both listed conditions are correctly stated
items.exp: 'Also in : Drug induced erythematosus. Mixed connective tissue disease.' PSC is not listed. (Book p1023)

items.q: Associated HLA and diseases — match — 1) HLA-DR03 2) HLA-DR04 … A) Rheumatoid arthritis, Type-1 DM, autoimmune thyroid disorders B) SLE (AKA lupoid hepatitis)
items.exp: 'HLA-DR03 association +ve : SLE (AKA Lupoid hepatitis)'; 'HLA-DR04 : Rheumatoid arthritis, Type-1 DM, Autoimmune thyroid disorders'. (Book p1023)

items.q: Fill up: AIH occurring with SLE on an HLA-DR03 background is 'AKA ______ hepatitis'.
The pathophysiology heading of AIH characterises the inflammation as which type?
Three 'unique features / histological findings' of AIH are branched in the diagram. Which is NOT one of them?
items.exp: Branches: Interface Hepatitis (Piecemeal necrosis), Emporipolesis (Engulfing cell without killing), Rosette formation. Ductopenia is PBC (p1021). (Book p1023)

items.q: Fill up the printed bracket: 'Emporipolesis (______ cell without ______)'.
Match — 1) filled purple circle 2) orange dots 3) blue open circle 4) red open circle … A) Hepatic artery B) Portal vein C) Central vein D) Hepatocytes
items.exp: Legend: Central vein (purple filled), Hepatocytes (orange dots), Portal track / Bile duct (open black), Portal vein (blue), Hepatic artery (red). (Book p1023)

items.q: In the second acinus cone of the diagram, inflammation is drawn spilling from the portal tract across a dashed line into the hepatocyte cone. What is that dashed boundary labelled, and what histological term results?
items.exp: Labels: 'Limiting plate' (dashed line) and 'Inflammation' (arrow) — inflammation breaching the limiting plate is interface / piecemeal hepatitis, the micrograph caption reading 'Interphase hepatitis'. (Book p1023)
